f3_program: collection("dani.cats", "cat", "dani", source("Dani has 3 cats; Binkie, Frankie and Spaatz"))
observe(at("dani.cats.count", "current"), 3, "count", source("Dani has 3 cats"))
member("dani.cats", "dani.cats.binkie", source("Dani has 3 cats; Binkie, Frankie and Spaatz"))
member("dani.cats", "dani.cats.frankie", source("Dani has 3 cats; Binkie, Frankie and Spaatz"))
member("dani.cats", "dani.cats.spaatz", source("Dani has 3 cats; Binkie, Frankie and Spaatz"))
collection("dani.cats.binkie.collar.gemstones", "gemstone", "dani.cats.binkie.collar", source("Each cat has a collar decorated with gemstones"))
collection("dani.cats.frankie.collar.gemstones", "gemstone", "dani.cats.frankie.collar", source("Each cat has a collar decorated with gemstones"))
collection("dani.cats.spaatz.collar.gemstones", "gemstone", "dani.cats.spaatz.collar", source("Each cat has a collar decorated with gemstones"))

multiple(at("dani.cats.binkie.collar.gemstones.count", "current"), at("dani.cats.frankie.collar.gemstones.count", "current"), 4, source("Binkie has four times as many gemstones on his collar as does Frankie"))

offset(at("dani.cats.spaatz.collar.gemstones.count", "current"), fraction(at("dani.cats.frankie.collar.gemstones.count", "current"), 1, 2), -2, "count", source("Spaatz has two less than half as many gemstones on her collar as does Frankie"))
observe(at("dani.cats.spaatz.collar.gemstones.count", "current"), 1, "count", source("Spaatz has 1 Gemstone on her collar"))
query("value", at("dani.cats.binkie.collar.gemstones.count", "current"))
collection("carlos.box.chocolates", "chocolate", "carlos.box", source("a box of 50 chocolates"))
observe(at("carlos.box.chocolates.count", "current"), 50, "count", source("50 chocolates"))
collection("carlos.box.chocolate_groups", "chocolate_group", "carlos.box", source("3 of them were caramels and twice as many were nougats"))
member("carlos.box.chocolate_groups", "carlos.box.chocolates.caramels", source("3 of them were caramels"))
member("carlos.box.chocolate_groups", "carlos.box.chocolates.nougats", source("twice as many were nougats"))
member("carlos.box.chocolate_groups", "carlos.box.chocolates.truffles", source("The number of truffles was equal to the number of caramels plus 6"))
member("carlos.box.chocolate_groups", "carlos.box.chocolates.peanut_clusters", source("The rest of the chocolates were peanut clusters"))
observe(at("carlos.box.chocolates.caramels.count", "current"), 3, "count", source("3 of them were caramels"))
multiple(at("carlos.box.chocolates.nougats.count", "current"), at("carlos.box.chocolates.caramels.count", "current"), 2, source("twice as many were nougats"))

offset(at("carlos.box.chocolates.truffles.count", "current"), at("carlos.box.chocolates.caramels.count", "current"), 6, "count", source("The number of truffles was equal to the number of caramels plus 6"))
partition("carlos.box.chocolate_groups", at("carlos.box.chocolates.count", "current"), source("The rest of the chocolates were peanut clusters"))
query("percentage_ratio", at("carlos.box.chocolates.peanut_clusters.count", "current"), at("carlos.box.chocolates.count", "current"))
collection("susie.chickens", "chicken", "susie", source("Susie and Britney each keep chickens, of two different breeds"))
collection("britney.chickens", "chicken", "britney", source("Susie and Britney each keep chickens, of two different breeds"))
collection("susie.chicken_breed_groups", "breed_group", "susie", source("Susie has 11 Rhode Island Reds and 6 Golden Comets"))
collection("britney.chicken_breed_groups", "breed_group", "britney", source("Britney has twice as many Rhode Island Reds as Susie, but only half as many Golden Comets"))
observe(at("susie.chicken_breed_groups.count", "current"), 2, "count", source("Susie and Britney each keep chickens, of two different breeds"))
observe(at("britney.chicken_breed_groups.count", "current"), 2, "count", source("Susie and Britney each keep chickens, of two different breeds"))
member("susie.chicken_breed_groups", "susie.chickens.rhode_island_reds", source("Susie has 11 Rhode Island Reds"))
member("susie.chicken_breed_groups", "susie.chickens.golden_comets", source("6 Golden Comets"))
member("britney.chicken_breed_groups", "britney.chickens.rhode_island_reds", source("Britney has twice as many Rhode Island Reds as Susie"))
member("britney.chicken_breed_groups", "britney.chickens.golden_comets", source("only half as many Golden Comets"))
observe(at("susie.chickens.rhode_island_reds.count", "current"), 11, "count", source("Susie has 11 Rhode Island Reds"))
observe(at("susie.chickens.golden_comets.count", "current"), 6, "count", source("6 Golden Comets"))
multiple(at("britney.chickens.rhode_island_reds.count", "current"), at("susie.chickens.rhode_island_reds.count", "current"), 2, source("Britney has twice as many Rhode Island Reds as Susie"))
fraction_of(at("britney.chickens.golden_comets.count", "current"), at("susie.chickens.golden_comets.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("only half as many Golden Comets"))
partition("susie.chicken_breed_groups", at("susie.chickens.count", "current"), source("Susie and Britney each keep chickens, of two different breeds"))
partition("britney.chicken_breed_groups", at("britney.chickens.count", "current"), source("Susie and Britney each keep chickens, of two different breeds"))
query("difference", at("susie.chickens.count", "current"), at("britney.chickens.count", "current"))
